metadata.title: Weathered Metal Banner on Distressed Stone

recipe.visualDefinition: A gritty, industrial composition featuring two curved, riveted metal banners set against a heavily distressed, vertical-grain stone or concrete wall with a deep purple and charcoal color wash.
coreVisualRelationships: Arched metal banners centered vertically and horizontally
Dark vertical staining contrasting with lighter stone texture
Metallic sheen on embossed lettering against matte background
Riveted edges anchoring the banners to the textured surface
coreInvariants: Distressed metal texture with rust and oxidation
Vertical drip-like stains in the background
Arched banner geometry with swallowtail ends on the top element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central banners; the top banner is larger and more complex, occupying the upper third, while the smaller banner sits in the lower third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large arched banner with swallowtail ends at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top arched banner, follow the vertical dark stain downward to the secondary banner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space on the left and right sides, filled with vertical stone textures and purple atmospheric lighting.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep muted purple and charcoal grey (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Light grey and silver (highlights on metal edges and lettering)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark brown and rust (weathering on the banners)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between dark stains and light stone highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to cool purples, greys, and warm rust tones

letterConstructionRules: Embossed or chiseled effect with metallic highlights
Letters follow the curve of the arched banners
Uniform stroke weight with slight weathering at the edges
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended tails on specific characters to follow the banner's arc
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in two different scales and banner shapes.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the wide, sturdy industrial feel suitable for embossing.
Geometric and wide, fits the masculine rock aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vertical-oriented background of a distressed stone wall. Include heavy vertical water stains and a dark purple-to-black color wash. The texture should look like weathered concrete or slate.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place two arched metal banners. The top banner should have swallowtail ends and rivets. The bottom banner is a simple curved rectangle with rivets. Add embossed, all-caps sans-serif text following the curve of each banner with a scratched metallic texture.

verificationChecks: Banners appear physically attached with rivets
Text follows the curve of the banner perfectly
Purple wash is moody and desaturated
Metal shows signs of rust and wear

adjustableVariables: Amount of rust on the metal
mustRedesign: Specific band name and album title
Exact placement of rivets if they match a trademarked layout
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the metal looks heavy and weathered
Check that the purple tone doesn't become neon
Verify the text is legible despite the distressing
Confirm the vertical stains look natural and not repetitive
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial Metal Banner + Distressed Stone Background + Purple/Charcoal Wash + Embossed Sans-Serif Typography
